title: Cambio, the AI-Native Crypto Exchange, Brings Swap Quotes to ChatGPT
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Panama City, Panama, November 1st, 2026] Cambio is an AI-native crypto exchange: a swap runs as one conversation, from the user’s first sentence to the payout, instead of token menus, network dropdowns and forms. Cambio is now also available in ChatGPT, through a new plugin that gives ChatGPT users a Cambio quote […]
